influences.context: I got inspiration and sympathy with the ideas of Brian Eno and Captain Beefheart, in the way of their doing music. They're both "Non Musician". They taught me there's no mistake or error, if you can improve it and make it into something interesting.

influences.name: Pink Floyd
influences.context: The Beatles and Pink Floyd showed me music can be ART, not just entertainment. When I was 19 years old I went to London to see the WALL show by Pink Floyd and that totally changed my life.

influences.name: Fred Frith
influences.context: A couple of years later I saw Fred Frith playing guitar improvisation in Tokyo, that changed my conventional perspective about music. I shouted to myself, "Yes, this is IT! This is what I want to do!". He did unleash me to uncharted terrain of music and sound.
